verdict.rationale: The axis applies: any SaaS product could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. But a probe of https://www.waveapps.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, the developer portal blocks non-browser agents with a 403, and the public pages document no agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
